category: maps, routing, geocoding and traffic API

free_tier.stated: free monthly requests per API, no credit card: 20K Geocoding, 20K Reverse Geocoding and 20K Routing requests a month, 2.5K Search API and 2.5K Matrix Routing requests a month, 200K vector map tiles a month; unused free amounts do not carry over and expire at the end of each month
free_tier.notes: the free use is the evaluation part of a Freemium account, which the FAQ says may be used for commercial applications; Freemium accounts are single-user; the free monthly allowance has no time limit, resets at the start of every billing cycle and is shared across the whole account, so several API keys draw from one pool

per_object_cap.stated: Batch Search takes up to 100 items a synchronous request and 10000 an asynchronous one; asynchronous results can be downloaded for 14 days

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to api.tomtom.com (for example /search/2/geocode/QUERY.json) with an API key created in MyTomTom; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 'You are missing valid authentication credentials'; the platform FAQ says API requests return 429 when free usage limits are exceeded, while the Geocode docs list 'Rate or volume limit exceeded' under 403 and give 429 for over QPS only, so the status of a request over the monthly free limit is unverified: behind a sign-up. Batch Search takes Geocode, Structured Geocode and Reverse Geocode items
tooling: any HTTP client; Maps SDK for JavaScript and mobile SDKs
chaining: 20K geocodes, 20K reverse geocodes and 20K routes a month with no card, at 5 queries a second; Bulk path: asynchronous Batch Search of up to 10000 geocode items a request, billed per underlying request, not per call (20 requests sent to a batch endpoint are billed as 20 transactions); which monthly free pool an item draws from is unverified: behind a sign-up

limits.value: 20K Geocoding, 20K Reverse Geocoding and 20K Routing requests a month on the free tier
5 queries a second by default for Geocoding, Reverse Geocoding, Routing, Search and Batch Search
results cached only for the maximum age of their cache-control headers; no other storing
10000 items an asynchronous Batch Search request, 100 a synchronous one

binding_note: 5 queries a second would pass a monthly 20K within the first day, so the monthly count is met first

identity_cost.detail: a MyTomTom account registered and confirmed by email; no credit card. The Register / sign in button of my.tomtom.com opens a hosted sign-in page whose first screen offers 'No account? Create one'; the other fields of the registration form are unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: the platform FAQ says API requests return 429 when free usage limits are exceeded, and the Geocode docs list rate or volume limit exceeded under 403; which status the monthly free limit answers is unverified: behind a sign-up; access made available for evaluation can be terminated at any time without notice; one evaluation subscription plan per account
confidence_note: the pricing page and its FAQ script, the terms, the QPS limits page, the platform FAQ, the Batch Search docs and the MyTomTom account docs were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401. The registration form beyond the first screen of its sign-in page is behind a sign-up; an account would show it and a keyed request would move the record to measured.
